title: Oxytocin
subtitle: The positive and negative effects of the chemical known as the ‘love hormone’

sentences.en: Oxytocin is a chemical, a hormone produced in the pituitary gland in the brain.
sentences.zh: 催产素是一种化学物质，也是一种由脑垂体产生的激素。

grammar.type: 同位语 + 过去分词定语
grammar.note: a hormone... 是 a chemical 的同位语；produced in... 修饰 hormone。

sentences.en: It was through various studies focusing on animals that scientists first became aware of the influence of oxytocin.
sentences.zh: 科学家最初正是通过多项动物研究，才认识到催产素的作用。

grammar.type: 强调句 + 分词定语
grammar.note: It was...that... 为强调句，强调 through various studies；focusing on animals 修饰 studies。

sentences.en: They discovered that it helps reinforce the bonds between prairie voles, which mate for life, and triggers the motherly behaviour that sheep show towards their newborn lambs.
sentences.zh: 他们发现，催产素可以加强终生配偶制草原田鼠之间的联系，还会触发母羊照顾新生羔羊的母性行为。

grammar.type: 宾语从句 + 两个定语从句
grammar.note: that 引导 discovered 的宾语从句；helps reinforce 与 triggers 并列；which 修饰 prairie voles，that 修饰 motherly behaviour。

sentences.en: It is also released by women in childbirth, strengthening the attachment between mother and baby.
sentences.zh: 女性分娩时也会释放催产素，从而加强母亲与婴儿之间的依恋。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 分词结果状语
grammar.note: is released 为被动；strengthening... 说明催产素释放产生的结果。

sentences.en: Few chemicals have as positive a reputation as oxytocin, which is sometimes referred to as the ‘love hormone’.
sentences.zh: 很少有化学物质能像催产素一样享有如此正面的名声；它有时被称为“爱情激素”。

grammar.type: as...as 比较 + 非限制性定语从句
grammar.note: as positive a reputation as 为同级比较；which 补充说明 oxytocin；refer to...as... 表示“把……称为……”。

sentences.en: One sniff of it can, it is claimed, make a person more trusting, empathetic, generous and cooperative.
sentences.zh: 据称，只吸入一次催产素，就能让人更信任他人、更有同理心，也更慷慨、更愿意合作。

grammar.type: 插入语 + make 复合结构
grammar.note: it is claimed 为插入语；make a person + 四个并列形容词，表示使人发生变化。

sentences.en: It is time, however, to revise this wholly optimistic view.
sentences.zh: 不过，现在应该修正这种完全乐观的看法了。

grammar.type: It is time to do
grammar.note: It 为形式主语，to revise... 是真正内容；however 为转折插入语。

sentences.en: A new wave of studies has shown that its effects vary greatly depending on the person and the circumstances, and it can impact on our social interactions for worse as well as for better.
sentences.zh: 新一轮研究表明，催产素的作用会因人和情境而有很大差异；它既可能改善社会交往，也可能使其恶化。

grammar.type: 宾语从句 + 分词状语 + 并列句
grammar.note: that 引导 shown 的宾语从句；depending on... 说明变化条件；and 连接另一个分句；for worse as well as for better 表示好坏两面。

sentences.en: Oxytocin's role in human behaviour first emerged in 2005.
sentences.zh: 催产素在人类行为中的作用于2005年首次受到关注。

grammar.type: 简单句
grammar.note: 主语为 Oxytocin's role in human behaviour；emerged 表示“显现、受到注意”。

sentences.en: In a groundbreaking experiment, Markus Heinrichs and his colleagues at the University of Freiburg, Germany, asked volunteers to do an activity in which they could invest money with an anonymous person who was not guaranteed to be honest.
sentences.zh: 德国弗赖堡大学的 Markus Heinrichs 及其同事开展了一项开创性实验：他们让志愿者参加一种投资活动，交易对象是身份不明、也不能保证诚实的人。

grammar.type: 双层定语从句 + ask sb to do
grammar.note: asked volunteers to do... 为主干；in which 修饰 activity；who was not guaranteed... 修饰 an anonymous person。

sentences.en: The team found that participants who had sniffed oxytocin via a nasal spray beforehand invested more money than those who received a placebo instead.
sentences.zh: 研究团队发现，事先通过鼻喷剂吸入催产素的参与者，比接受安慰剂的参与者投入了更多资金。

grammar.type: 宾语从句 + 定语从句 + 比较
grammar.note: that 引导 found 的宾语从句；两个 who 从句分别修饰 participants 和 those；more...than... 构成比较。

sentences.en: The study was the start of research into the effects of oxytocin on human interactions.
sentences.zh: 这项研究开启了对催产素如何影响人际交往的探索。

grammar.type: 主系表结构
grammar.note: The study 为主语，was 为系动词；research into... 说明研究对象。

sentences.en: ‘For eight years, it was quite a lonesome field,’ Heinrichs recalls.
sentences.zh: Heinrichs 回忆说：“八年里，这一直是一个相当冷清的研究领域。”

grammar.type: 直接引语
grammar.note: 引语为主系表结构；Heinrichs recalls 说明说话者。

sentences.en: ‘Now, everyone is interested.’
sentences.zh: “现在，人人都对此感兴趣。”

grammar.type: 简单句
grammar.note: everyone 作主语，is interested 为系表结构；语境中省略了 interested in oxytocin。

sentences.en: These follow-up studies have shown that after a sniff of the hormone, people become more charitable, better at reading emotions on others' faces and at communicating constructively in arguments.
sentences.zh: 后续研究表明，吸入催产素后，人会更愿意行善，也更善于从他人面部读取情绪，并能在争论中进行建设性沟通。

grammar.type: 宾语从句 + 并列表语
grammar.note: that 引导 shown 的宾语从句；charitable、better at reading...、better at communicating... 为并列表语，后两个共用 better at。

sentences.en: Together, the results fuelled the view that oxytocin universally enhanced the positive aspects of our social nature.
sentences.zh: 这些结果共同强化了一种看法：催产素会普遍增强人类社会性的积极方面。

grammar.type: 同位语从句
grammar.note: that 从句解释 the view 的具体内容；fuelled 表示研究结果推动了这一看法。

sentences.en: Then, after a few years, contrasting findings began to emerge.
sentences.zh: 几年后，与上述结论相反的发现开始出现。

grammar.type: 简单句
grammar.note: after a few years 为时间状语；contrasting findings 是主语。

sentences.en: Simone Shamay-Tsoory at the University of Haifa, Israel, found that when volunteers played a competitive game, those who inhaled the hormone showed more pleasure when they beat other players, and felt more envy when others won.
sentences.zh: 以色列海法大学的 Simone Shamay-Tsoory 发现，在竞争性游戏中，吸入催产素的志愿者击败别人时更高兴，别人获胜时则更嫉妒。

grammar.type: 宾语从句 + 多个时间从句
grammar.note: that 引导 found 的宾语从句；when volunteers... 说明实验情境；who inhaled... 修饰 those；后两个 when 分别说明愉悦和嫉妒出现的时间。

sentences.en: What's more, administering oxytocin also has sharply contrasting outcomes depending on a person's disposition.
sentences.zh: 此外，使用催产素会因人的性格倾向不同而产生截然相反的结果。

grammar.type: 动名词主语 + 分词状语
grammar.note: administering oxytocin 为动名词主语；depending on... 说明结果取决于什么。

sentences.en: Jennifer Bartz from Mount Sinai School of Medicine, New York, found that it improves people's ability to read emotions, but only if they are not very socially adept to begin with.
sentences.zh: 纽约西奈山医学院的 Jennifer Bartz 发现，催产素能提高人们识别情绪的能力，但只对原本不太擅长社交的人有效。

grammar.type: 宾语从句 + if 条件从句
grammar.note: that 引导 found 的宾语从句；but only if... 限定这一效果成立的条件；to begin with 表示“原本”。

sentences.en: Her research also shows that oxytocin in fact reduces cooperation in subjects who are particularly anxious or sensitive to rejection.
sentences.zh: 她的研究还显示，对特别焦虑或很怕被拒绝的受试者来说，催产素实际上会降低合作意愿。

grammar.type: 宾语从句 + 定语从句
grammar.note: that 引导 shows 的宾语从句；who... 修饰 subjects；anxious 与 sensitive 并列。

sentences.en: Another discovery is that oxytocin's effects vary depending on who we are interacting with.
sentences.zh: 另一项发现是，催产素的作用还会因互动对象不同而改变。

grammar.type: 表语从句 + 宾语从句
grammar.note: that 引导表语从句；who we are interacting with 作 depending on 的宾语。

sentences.en: Studies conducted by Carolyn DeClerck of the University of Antwerp, Belgium, revealed that people who had received a dose of oxytocin actually became less cooperative when dealing with complete strangers.
sentences.zh: 比利时安特卫普大学 Carolyn DeClerck 的研究显示，接受一剂催产素的人在面对完全陌生的人时，反而更不愿意合作。

grammar.type: 过去分词定语 + 宾语从句
grammar.note: conducted by... 修饰 Studies；that 引导 revealed 的宾语从句；when dealing... 为省略式时间从句。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Carsten De Dreu at the University of Amsterdam in the Netherlands discovered that volunteers given oxytocin showed favouritism: Dutch men became quicker to associate positive words with Dutch names than with foreign ones, for example.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，荷兰阿姆斯特丹大学的 Carsten De Dreu 发现，接受催产素的志愿者会表现出偏袒。例如，荷兰男性会更快地把正面词语与荷兰名字而不是外国名字联系起来。

grammar.type: 宾语从句 + 过去分词定语 + 冒号解释
grammar.note: that 引导 discovered 的宾语从句；given oxytocin 修饰 volunteers；冒号后给出 favouritism 的例子；than 构成比较。

sentences.en: According to De Dreu, oxytocin drives people to care for those in their social circles and defend them from outside dangers.
sentences.zh: De Dreu 认为，催产素会促使人们关心自己社交圈中的人，并保护他们免受外部危险。

grammar.type: drive sb to do + 并列动词
grammar.note: drives people to care for... and defend... 中 care 与 defend 并列，共用 to。

sentences.en: So, it appears that oxytocin strengthens biases, rather than promoting general goodwill, as was previously thought.
sentences.zh: 因此，催产素似乎会加强偏见，而不是像过去认为的那样普遍增进善意。

grammar.type: It appears that + rather than
grammar.note: It 为形式主语，that 从句是真正内容；rather than 后接动名词；as was previously thought 为方式比较从句。

sentences.en: There were signs of these subtleties from the start.
sentences.zh: 这些细微差异其实从一开始就已有迹象。

grammar.type: There be 句型
grammar.note: There were 表示存在；of these subtleties 修饰 signs。

sentences.en: Bartz has recently shown that in almost half of the existing research results, oxytocin influenced only certain individuals or in certain circumstances.
sentences.zh: Bartz 最近指出，在现有研究结果中，近一半显示催产素只影响某些人，或只在某些情境下产生影响。

grammar.type: 宾语从句 + 并列限定
grammar.note: that 引导 shown 的宾语从句；only certain individuals 与 in certain circumstances 从对象和情境两方面限定作用。

sentences.en: Where once researchers took no notice of such findings, now a more nuanced understanding of oxytocin's effects is propelling investigations down new lines.
sentences.zh: 研究人员过去忽视这类结果，如今对催产素作用的理解更细致了，也由此推动研究转向新的方向。

grammar.type: where 对比从句 + 现在进行时
grammar.note: Where once... 与 now... 形成今昔对比；is propelling 表示正在推动；down new lines 表示沿新方向。

sentences.en: To Bartz, the key to understanding what the hormone does lies in pinpointing its core function rather than in cataloguing its seemingly endless effects.
sentences.zh: Bartz 认为，理解这种激素的关键在于找出它的核心功能，而不是罗列它似乎无穷无尽的作用。

grammar.type: what 宾语从句 + lie in doing
grammar.note: what the hormone does 作 understanding 的宾语；the key lies in... 为主干；pinpointing 与 cataloguing 由 rather than 对比。

sentences.en: There are several hypotheses which are not mutually exclusive.
sentences.zh: 目前有几种假说，它们彼此并不排斥。

grammar.type: There be + 定语从句
grammar.note: which are not mutually exclusive 修饰 hypotheses，表示这些解释可以同时成立。

sentences.en: Oxytocin could help to reduce anxiety and fear.
sentences.zh: 催产素可能有助于减轻焦虑和恐惧。

grammar.type: 情态动词 + help to do
grammar.note: could 表示一种可能解释；help to reduce 表示“有助于减少”。

sentences.en: Or it could simply motivate people to seek out social connections.
sentences.zh: 也可能只是促使人们主动寻找社会联系。

grammar.type: motivate sb to do
grammar.note: could 表可能性；motivate people to seek out... 表示促使人去寻找。

sentences.en: She believes that oxytocin acts as a chemical spotlight that shines on social clues - a shift in posture, a flicker of the eyes, a dip in the voice - making people more attuned to their social environment.
sentences.zh: 她认为，催产素像一束化学聚光灯，会突出姿势变化、眼神闪动、音调下降等社交线索，使人更敏锐地感知周围的社交环境。

grammar.type: 宾语从句 + 定语从句 + 分词结果状语
grammar.note: that 引导 believes 的宾语从句；that shines... 修饰 spotlight；破折号中列举 social clues；making... 说明结果。

sentences.en: This would explain why it makes us more likely to look others in the eye and improves our ability to identify emotions.
sentences.zh: 这可以解释为什么催产素会让我们更愿意直视他人，也会提高我们识别情绪的能力。

grammar.type: why 宾语从句 + 并列谓语
grammar.note: why 从句作 explain 的宾语；makes 与 improves 为从句中的并列谓语；make us more likely to do 为复合结构。

sentences.en: But it could also make things worse for people who are overly sensitive or prone to interpreting social cues in the worst light.
sentences.zh: 但对过度敏感、容易把社交线索往最坏处理解的人来说，催产素也可能使情况变得更糟。

grammar.type: make 复合结构 + 定语从句
grammar.note: make things worse 为 make + 宾语 + 补语；who... 修饰 people；sensitive 与 prone 并列。

sentences.en: Perhaps we should not be surprised that the oxytocin story has become more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 催产素的研究结论变得更加复杂难解，我们或许不该感到意外。

grammar.type: 情感形容词 + that 从句
grammar.note: that 从句说明 surprised 的具体原因；has become 为现在完成时。

words.def: 令人困惑的；复杂难解的

sentences.en: The hormone is found in everything from octopuses to sheep, and its evolutionary roots stretch back half a billion years.
sentences.zh: 从章鱼到绵羊，许多动物体内都有这种激素；它的进化根源可以追溯到五亿年前。

grammar.type: 并列句 + from...to...
grammar.note: and 连接两个独立分句；from octopuses to sheep 表示范围；stretch back 表示追溯到。

sentences.en: ‘It's a very simple and ancient molecule that has been co-opted for many different functions,’ says Sue Carter at the University of Illinois, Chicago, USA.
sentences.zh: 美国伊利诺伊大学芝加哥分校的 Sue Carter 说：“这是一种非常简单而古老的分子，后来被借用于许多不同功能。”

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 引述倒装
grammar.note: that has been co-opted... 修饰 molecule；says Sue Carter 为引述中的主谓倒装。

sentences.en: ‘It affects primitive parts of the brain like the amygdala, so it's going to have many effects on just about everything.’
sentences.zh: “它会影响杏仁核等大脑原始区域，所以几乎会对一切产生多方面作用。”

grammar.type: so 结果并列句
grammar.note: so 连接原因与结果；like the amygdala 举例说明 primitive parts of the brain。

sentences.en: Bartz agrees.
sentences.zh: Bartz 也同意这一看法。

grammar.type: 简单句
grammar.note: agree 的具体内容承接前文。

sentences.en: ‘Oxytocin probably does some very basic things, but once you add our higher-order thinking and social situations, these basic processes could manifest in different ways depending on individual differences and context.’
sentences.zh: “催产素可能只完成一些很基础的工作，但一旦加入人类的高级思维和社会情境，这些基础过程便可能因个体差异和具体环境而呈现出不同结果。”

grammar.type: but 转折 + once 条件/时间从句
grammar.note: but 连接转折；once you add... 表示条件；depending on... 说明表现方式取决于个体和语境。
